verdict.rationale: There is direct evidence of an official scaffolding method (npx degit solidjs/templates/js my-app) and Vite ecosystem integration, supporting quick project setup, but no evidence of a dedicated first-party CLI (like create-solid) with guided prompts, no walkthrough of run/start commands, and no independent hands-on account of the scaffolding experience. missing for 10: dedicated official CLI tool details, documented run/start steps, independent verification of setup time and experience.
